new.headline: Keep the volume down this week and focus on recovery, you can stay on target without adding more mileage.

answers.question: I ran way more than the plan and felt fine. Can I keep this up?
answers.answer: I ran way more than the plan and felt fine. Can I keep this up? Yes, if you’re not feeling any new pain and can stay on plan mileage, you can keep the higher volume, but it’s safest to bring it back to the planned numbers to avoid overtraining.

new.analysis: The athlete ran significantly over the prescribed plan, adding about 10 miles and even running a rest day. The plan will be scaled back to preserve recovery while keeping volume in the build phase. One quality session and a long run remain, with a medium‑long run added to balance volume. The plan stays in build, 80 % easy runs, and each session has a purpose.
